name: Open Refrigerator
description: Pull open the refrigerator door to inspect its contents.
successMessage: You pull open the fridge door. A wave of cool air pours out over your hands.

name: Close Refrigerator
description: Push the refrigerator door closed with a reassuring magnetic seal.
successMessage: You gently nudge the fridge door shut until the rubber seal clicks tight.

name: Ignite Gas Stove
description: Twist the burner knob and click the gas lighter to start a flame.
successMessage: Click-click-whoosh! A clean ring of blue flame bursts to life on the burner.

name: Turn Off Gas Stove
description: Turn off the burner completely.
successMessage: You switch off the stove knob. The blue flame vanishes instantly.

name: Turn On Bedside Lamp
description: Click the switch on the bedside brass lamp.
successMessage: Click. The bedside lamp fills the bedroom with a mellow golden glow.

name: Turn Off Bedside Lamp
description: Switch off the bedside lamp.
successMessage: Click. The warm light fades and the room settles into shadows.

name: Power On Computer
description: Press the power button on the desktop tower.
successMessage: The PC fans whir up, and the monitors illuminate in crisp high definition.

name: Shut Down Computer
description: Select Shut Down and wait for the monitors to power off.
successMessage: You safely shut down the system. The monitors blink off and quiet returns.

name: Open Wardrobe
description: Swing open the wardrobe doors.
successMessage: The wooden doors creak softly open, revealing your organized clothes.

name: Close Wardrobe
description: Shut the wardrobe doors.
successMessage: You swing the wardrobe doors shut.

name: Fill Glass with Water
description: Hold the glass under the kitchen tap or water filter and fill it up.
successMessage: Cool, filtered water pours cleanly into the tumbler until it is full.

name: Drink Water from Glass
description: Take a long, refreshing drink from the water glass.
successMessage: Ah! You drink the cool water. Your throat feels completely refreshed.

name: Drink from Copper Flask
description: Uncap the copper flask and take a swig of naturally ionized water.
successMessage: You take a satisfying drink from the copper bottle. Crisp and thirst-quenching.

name: Flush Toilet
description: Press the chrome dual-flush button on the toilet cistern.
successMessage: Whoosh! A strong swirl of clean water flushes through the bowl.

name: Look in Mirror
description: Examine your face, hair, and expression in the bathroom mirror.
successMessage: You check yourself in the glass. Eyes clear, hair neat, looking ready for the day.

name: Wipe Steamy Mirror
description: Wipe away condensation from the bathroom mirror with a towel or your hand.
successMessage: With a smooth, sweeping motion, you wipe away the condensation from the mirror. Your clear reflection beams back at you, crisp and bright.

name: Throw Away Trash
description: Dispose of waste or scraps into the room's trash bin.
successMessage: You step on the pedal and toss the waste cleanly into the trash bin.

name: Empty Trash Bin
description: Tie up the full trash bag and replace it with a fresh clean liner.
successMessage: You bundle up the rubbish bag, carry it to the disposal point, and line the bin with a clean sheet. Pristine and sanitary.

name: Put Clothes in Laundry Basket
description: Place soiled garments and used towels into the woven laundry hamper.
successMessage: You drop your worn clothes and damp towel into the woven laundry hamper. The bathroom looks clean and tidy.

name: Empty Laundry Basket
description: Take out the accumulated laundry hamper bundle to prepare for washing.
successMessage: You gather the full basket of laundry for washing, leaving the hamper empty and fresh.

name: Turn On Kitchen Tap
description: Turn the lever faucet on the sink.
successMessage: Water rushes steadily into the stainless sink basin.

name: Turn Off Kitchen Tap
description: Turn off the faucet completely.
successMessage: You shut off the tap with a smooth turn. Not a single drip.

name: Pick Up Item
description: Hold the portable item in your hands.
successMessage: You pick up the item and hold it safely.

name: Pick Math Textbook
description: Take the mathematics textbook down from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You lift the math textbook from the shelf and hold it carefully.

name: Pick Physics Textbook
description: Take the physics textbook down from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You pull the physics textbook off the shelf and carry it in your hands.

name: Pick Chemistry Textbook
description: Take the chemistry textbook down from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You take the chemistry textbook off the shelf and cradle it in your hands.

name: Pick Psychology Book
description: Take the psychology book off the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You pick the psychology book from the shelf and carry it with you.

name: Pick Mohit's Notebook
description: Take Mohit's notebook from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You pick up Mohit's notebook and hold it carefully in your hands.

name: Pick Aria's Notebook
description: Take Aria's notebook from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You take Aria's notebook off the shelf and hold it gently.

name: Put Down Item
description: Set down the held item onto a nearby surface.
successMessage: You place the item down neatly.

name: Make the Bed
description: Straighten the bedsheet, pull corners taut, and fluff up the pillows.
successMessage: You smooth out all wrinkles and tuck in the corners. The bed looks crisp and hotel-neat.

name: Wipe Kitchen Counter
description: Dampen a soft microfiber cloth and wipe down the black granite countertop.
successMessage: The black granite gleams smoothly in the morning light, spotless and pristine.

name: Sip Water
description: Take a quick sip of water from the glass.
successMessage: A cool sip wets your mouth and eases your thirst.

name: Sip from Flask
description: Take a quick sip from the copper flask.
successMessage: A refreshing sip from the flask takes the edge off your thirst.

name: Browse the Bookshelf
description: Look over the textbooks and notebooks on the shelf.
successMessage: You scan the shelf, spotting math, physics, chemistry, psychology, and two familiar notebooks.

name: Browse the Web
description: Browse websites and read a few interesting articles.
successMessage: A few interesting pages later, you have learned something new.

name: See Photos
description: Open the photo gallery and look through saved pictures.
successMessage: You scroll through a few familiar photos and pause on a favorite.

name: Take a Selfie
description: Use the webcam to take a quick selfie.
successMessage: The webcam captures a quick photo.

name: Record a Video
description: Record a short video with the computer's webcam.
successMessage: You record a short clip and save it to the computer.

name: Turn On Light
description: Switch on the light in this room.
successMessage: The room light comes on.

name: Turn Off Light
description: Switch off the light in this room.
successMessage: The light goes off.

name: Take a Snack
description: Take a small snack from the open refrigerator.
successMessage: You grab a small snack from the fridge.

name: Take a Cold Drink
description: Take a chilled drink from the open refrigerator.
successMessage: A cold drink quickly refreshes you.

name: Prepare a Snack
description: Arrange a quick snack on the counter.
successMessage: You prepare a small snack on the counter.

name: Wash Hands
description: Wash your hands at the kitchen sink.
successMessage: You wash your hands under cool running water.

name: Wash the Dishes
description: Wash dirty plates and utensils with dish soap at the kitchen sink.
successMessage: You scrub the plates with dish soap under running tap water and rinse away all grease. The steel plate sparkles, clean and stacked to dry.

name: Tidy the Desk
description: Put papers and stationery back in their places.
successMessage: You straighten the desk and clear a little space to work.

name: Check Phone
description: Pick up your phone and check for the time or new messages.
successMessage: You glance over your notifications and the time on your phone screen.

name: Check Messages
description: Open chat applications and catch up on messages from friends and family.
successMessage: You scroll through your unread messages and reply to friends, feeling warmly connected.

name: Play Alarm
description: Sound a test alarm chime on your phone to wake up or check volume.
successMessage: A brisk, bright alarm tone rings out from your phone, snapping you to attention.

name: Listen to Music on Phone
description: Play favorite acoustic melodies or soothing tracks on your phone.
successMessage: Gentle acoustic tunes play softly from your phone speakers, filling the air with soothing rhythm.

name: Turn On Shower
description: Turn on the shower and adjust the water temperature.
successMessage: Warm water begins to flow from the shower.

name: Turn Off Shower
description: Turn off the running shower.
successMessage: You turn off the shower and the water settles to a drip.

name: Turn On TV
description: Power on the living room smart television.
successMessage: The smart TV powers on with a crisp chime, displaying the home dashboard.

name: Turn Off TV
description: Power down the television display.
successMessage: You click the power button and the screen gently fades to black.

name: Play Music on Soundbar
description: Stream relaxing classical and acoustic indie melodies through the soundbar.
successMessage: Warm, mellow acoustic guitar and sitar melodies flow smoothly through the room.

name: Stop Speaker Music
description: Pause or stop music playback on the soundbar.
successMessage: The music gracefully fades out, leaving peaceful silence in the living room.

name: Wipe Coffee Table
description: Wipe down the coffee table surface with a clean cloth.
successMessage: You buff the polished sheesham tabletop until the warm wood gleams.

name: Inspect Money Plant
description: Check the soil moisture and leaves of the indoor potted plant.
successMessage: You check the money plant. Its trailing vines and leaves are healthy and vibrant.

name: Wipe Plant Leaves
description: Gently dust off the glossy leaves with a soft damp cloth.
successMessage: You gently wipe each leaf until the money plant glows with a deep emerald shine.

name: Refill Watering Can
description: Refill the watering can at the balcony utility tap.
successMessage: You top up the watering can with cool fresh water from the brass tap.

name: Study Math Textbook
description: Work through calculus theorems, linear algebra matrices, and complex problem sets.
successMessage: You work through calculus problems and matrix transformations. The equations click into place with clear logic (+15 studiousness, +5 mental energy, -10 boredom).

name: Study Physics Textbook
description: Study classical mechanics, energy balance equations, and thermodynamics theory.
successMessage: You study classical mechanics and thermodynamics, diagramming force vectors and thermodynamic cycles (+15 studiousness, -10 boredom).

name: Study Chemistry Textbook
description: Review organic reaction mechanisms, molecular orbitals, and solution stoichiometry.
successMessage: You review organic chemistry pathways and molecular structures with keen curiosity (+15 studiousness, -10 boredom).

name: Read Psychology Book
description: Read underlined chapters on human behavior, perception, and emotional empathy.
successMessage: You read insightful passages on cognitive empathy, perception, and human behavior, gaining a richer understanding of people (+15 sociability, -10 stress).

name: Read Mohit's Notebook
description: Reflect on your personal journal entries, brainstorms, and creative project sketches.
successMessage: You flip through your personal journal, revisiting sketches, reflections, and future goals. A reassuring calm sets in (+10 happiness, -15 stress).

name: Read Aria's Notebook
description: Open Aria's private cloth-bound notebook resting on the shelf.
successMessage: You peek into Aria's private notebook. An immediate pang of guilt and acute tension grips your chest (+20 stress).

name: Open Brass Masala Dabba
description: Lift the engraved brass lid off the traditional spice container.
successMessage: You lift the heavy brass lid. The aromatic fragrance of cloves, cardamom, turmeric, and mustard seeds drifts into the air.

name: Close Brass Masala Dabba
description: Place the brass lid securely back onto the masala dabba.
successMessage: You press the brass lid closed with a gentle clink, sealing in the freshness of the whole spices.

name: Inspect Masala Dabba Spices
description: Look into the circular brass katoris holding cloves (laung), cardamom (elaichi), turmeric (haldi), and mustard seeds (rai).
successMessage: You examine the seven brass compartments: shiny black mustard seeds (rai), fragrant green cardamoms (elaichi), pungent whole cloves (laung), and bright yellow turmeric (haldi) — all neatly arranged for everyday cooking.

name: Pinch Spices for Cooking
description: Take a pinch of mustard seeds and turmeric from the masala dabba to temper in hot oil on the stove.
successMessage: You pinch a spoonful of mustard seeds and golden turmeric from the brass dabba, ready to sizzle in the hot pan.
